title: Runtime plan artifact blocks finalize
description: agent-run-plan.md runtime dirty repeatedly blocks integration or finalize.
impact: Finalize and integration can stall on a generated runtime artifact.
root_cause: Runtime execution plans are treated like durable source artifacts.
evidence: agent-run-plan.md dirty state observed during finalize
self-repair has to restore or commit a runtime-only plan file

title: Completed event missing for existing result
description: Result artifact exists but completed event is absent from event stream.
impact: Queue and status readers disagree on whether work is complete.
root_cause: Completion reconciliation trusts events only and does not backfill from result artifacts.
evidence: result exists but completed event missing
Doctor reconciliation finds task status drift

title: Report schema missing next action
description: Agent reports omit next Agent recommendation or verification fields.
impact: Planner cannot reliably continue closed-loop execution.
root_cause: Report contract is enforced by convention rather than by normalization gate.

title: Worktree baseline drift before claim
description: Agent worktrees fall behind main before claim or merge.
impact: Workers see stale queue or stale prompt state.
root_cause: Baseline sync is not always executed before every read path.
evidence: manual rebase requests appeared in earlier loops

title: Queue bookkeeping conflict during integration
description: Queue JSON bookkeeping conflicts repeatedly during integration.
impact: Integration requires conflict handling and can delay safe merge.
root_cause: Mutable queue JSON is used as both write model and read model.
